lines.scene: Lady Liu. The war can wait
outside the screen.
Xue, you say beauty
like a man who has only
ever been introduced to steel.
Look. I am not a campaign.
I am the pause in one.
Your armor still has the road on it.
Good. I like the evidence.
Come in. Leave the weapon by the door.
If you stare, stare like you mean
to remember a face in a snow year.
I will remember a man
who put the weapon down
and did not become smaller.
Be this, for the length of a looking.
Your hand is careful. Surprising.
Don't apologize. Careful is rare
in a room full of victory.
I am not your prize.
I am the person who decided
the general could sit.
Sit, then.
If the court asks what we were
tell them two names shared a quiet
that didn't need their ranks.
Liu.
Xue.
The lamp likes us better this way.
Tomorrow the war gets you back.
Tonight you found the right room.
